fullPassage: Dear Members of the City Sports Center, We greatly appreciate your continued use of our sports center. As previously announced, we will be conducting essential maintenance on our underground parking lot. As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance. We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.

questions.passage: We greatly appreciate your (A)[continued / discontinued] use of our sports center. As previously announced, we will be conducting (B)[essential / optional] maintenance on our underground parking lot. As a result, the facility will be (C)[unavailable / accessible] from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance. We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 회원의 지속적인(continued) 이용에 감사하며, 필수적인(essential) 보수 공사를 진행하므로 시설이 이용 불가(unavailable)하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① continued — essential — unavailable: 원문과 일치
❌ ② discontinued(중단된): continued의 반의어
❌ ③ optional(선택적인): essential의 반의어
❌ ④ accessible(접근 가능한): unavailable의 반의어
det.tip: continued = 지속적인, essential = 필수적인, unavailable = 이용 불가한

questions.passage: Dear Members of the City Sports Center, We greatly appreciate your continued use of our sports center. As previously announced, we will be conducting essential maintenance on our underground parking lot. As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly (A)[ask / forbid] you to use the (B)[temporary / permanent] outdoor parking lot located (C)[across / away] from the main entrance. We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 이 기간 동안 정문 건너편(across)에 위치한 임시(temporary) 야외 주차장을 이용해 달라고 요청(ask)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ ask — temporary — across: 원문과 일치
❌ ① forbid(금지하다): ask의 반의어
❌ ② permanent(영구적인): temporary의 반의어
❌ ④ away(멀리): across from = ~건너편에
det.tip: ask = 요청하다, temporary = 임시의, across from = ~건너편에

questions.passage: We are (A)[committed / reluctant] to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely (B)[apologize / boast] for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and (C)[cooperation / resistance].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 가능한 빨리 작업을 완료하는 데 전념(committed)하며, 불편에 대해 사과(apologize)하고 인내와 협조(cooperation)에 감사한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② committed — apologize — cooperation: 원문과 일치
❌ ① reluctant(꺼리는): committed의 반의어
❌ ③ boast(자랑하다): apologize와 반대 어감
❌ ④ resistance(저항): cooperation의 반의어
det.tip: committed to = ~에 전념하는, apologize for = ~에 대해 사과하다

questions.passage: We greatly appreciate your continued use of our sports center. As previously announced, we will be conducting essential ①<u>maintenance</u> on our underground parking lot. As a result, the underground parking ②<u>facility</u> will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. We kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main ③<u>entrance</u>. We sincerely apologize for any ④<u>convenience</u> this may cause.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ convenience(편리함) → inconvenience(불편): 공사로 인한 '불편'에 대해 사과하는 맥락이므로 convenience는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① maintenance(보수): 원문 일치
✅ ② facility(시설): 원문 일치
✅ ③ entrance(입구): 원문 일치
❌ ④ convenience(편리함): 원문은 inconvenience(불편) — 반의어로 교체됨
det.tip: inconvenience(불편) ↔ convenience(편리함)

questions.passage: As previously ①<u>announced</u>, we will be conducting essential maintenance on our underground parking lot. The underground parking facility will be ②<u>available</u> from April 1st to April 7th. We are ③<u>committed</u> to completing the work as quickly as ④<u>possible</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② available(이용 가능한) → unavailable(이용 불가한): 보수 공사로 인해 주차장을 '이용할 수 없다'는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① announced(발표된): 원문 일치
❌ ② available(이용 가능한): 원문은 unavailable(이용 불가한) — 반의어로 교체됨
✅ ③ committed(전념하는): 원문 일치
✅ ④ possible(가능한): 원문 일치
det.tip: unavailable(이용 불가한) ↔ available(이용 가능한)

questions.passage: As previously announced, we will be conducting essential __________ on our underground parking lot. As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 지하 주차장에 대한 필수 보수 공사(maintenance)를 실시할 예정이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ maintenance(보수): 시설 이용 불가의 원인
❌ ① entertainment(오락): 문맥과 무관
❌ ② advertisement(광고): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ performance(공연): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: maintenance = 보수, 유지보수 | conduct maintenance = 보수 공사를 실시하다

questions.passage: The underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the __________ outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 기간 동안 임시(temporary) 야외 주차장을 이용해 달라는 요청.
det.analysis:
✅ ① temporary(임시의): 공사 기간 동안의 대체 주차장
❌ ② permanent(영구적인): 공사 기간 한정이므로 부적절
❌ ③ abandoned(버려진): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ restricted(제한된): 이용을 권유하므로 부적절
det.tip: temporary = 임시의 ↔ permanent = 영구적인

questions.passage: We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely __________ for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 불편에 대해 진심으로 사과(apologize)하고 인내와 협조에 감사한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ apologize(사과하다): 불편에 대한 사과 표현
❌ ① celebrate(축하하다): 문맥과 정반대
❌ ② compete(경쟁하다): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ hesitate(망설이다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: apologize for = ~에 대해 사과하다 | sincerely apologize = 진심으로 사과하다

questions.passage: Dear Members of the City Sports Center, We greatly appreciate your continued use of our sports center. As previously announced, we will be conducting <u>essential</u> maintenance on our underground parking lot. As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 essential의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: essential = 필수적인, necessary = 필요한 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ② necessary(필요한): essential의 동의어
❌ ① unnecessary(불필요한): 반의어
❌ ③ minor(사소한): 다른 의미
❌ ④ harmful(해로운): 다른 의미
det.tip: essential = necessary = vital = indispensable = 필수적인

questions.passage: As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance. We are <u>committed</u> to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 committed의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: committed = 전념하는, dedicated = 헌신적인 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ③ dedicated(헌신적인): committed의 동의어
❌ ① reluctant(꺼리는): 반의어
❌ ② indifferent(무관심한): 반대 의미
❌ ④ opposed(반대하는): 반대 의미
det.tip: committed to = dedicated to = devoted to = ~에 전념하는

questions.passage: As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance. We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any <u>inconvenience</u> this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 inconvenience의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: inconvenience = 불편, trouble = 어려움, 불편 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ① trouble(불편): inconvenience의 동의어
❌ ② comfort(편안함): 반의어
❌ ③ benefit(이익): 반대 의미
❌ ④ pleasure(기쁨): 반대 의미
det.tip: inconvenience = trouble = difficulty = 불편, 어려움

questions.passage: As previously announced, we will be conducting essential maintenance on our underground parking lot. As a result, the underground parking facility will be <u>unavailable</u> from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance. We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 unavailable의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: unavailable = 이용 불가한 ↔ accessible = 접근 가능한
det.analysis:
❌ ④ accessible(접근 가능한): unavailable의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① closed(닫힌): 유사어
✅ ② inaccessible(접근 불가한): 유사어
✅ ③ shut down(폐쇄된): 유사어
det.tip: unavailable(이용 불가한) ↔ available = accessible = 이용 가능한

questions.passage: As a result, the underground parking facility will be unavailable from April 1st to April 7th. During this period, we kindly ask you to use the <u>temporary</u> outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance. We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 temporary의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: temporary = 임시의 ↔ permanent = 영구적인
det.analysis:
❌ ② permanent(영구적인): temporary의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① provisional(임시의): 동의어
✅ ③ short-term(단기의): 유사어
✅ ④ interim(중간의, 임시의): 유사어
det.tip: temporary = provisional = interim = 임시의 ↔ permanent = 영구적인

questions.passage: As previously announced, we will be <u>conducting</u> essential maintenance on our underground parking lot.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 conducting이 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: conducting = 이 문맥에서 '실시하다(carrying out)'의 의미. conduct는 '지휘하다', '행동하다' 등 다의어.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ carrying out(실시하다): conduct maintenance = 보수 공사를 실시하다
❌ ① directing an orchestra(오케스트라를 지휘하다): 다른 의미
❌ ② behaving oneself(행동하다): 다른 의미
❌ ④ transmitting electricity(전기를 전도하다): 다른 의미
det.tip: conduct는 다의어: ① 지휘하다 ② 행동하다 ③ 실시하다 ④ 전도하다 | 이 글에서는 ③

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the work needed to keep a building or machine in good condition"

det.korean: "건물이나 기계를 양호한 상태로 유지하기 위해 필요한 작업" = maintenance(유지보수)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ maintenance(유지보수): 건물/기계를 양호하게 유지하는 작업
❌ ① construction(건설): 새로 짓는 작업
❌ ② demolition(철거): 허무는 작업
❌ ③ decoration(장식): 꾸미는 작업
det.tip: maintenance = 유지보수, 정비 | maintain = 유지하다

questions.passage: We greatly appreciate your continued use of our sports center. As __________ announced, we will be conducting essential maintenance on our underground parking lot.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 부분을 문맥에 맞게 어형 변환하시오.

"As __________(previous) announced, we will be conducting essential maintenance."

det.korean: previous → previously(이전에): 동사 announced를 수식하는 부사가 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ previously(이전에, 부사): previous(형용사)의 부사형, announced를 수식
det.tip: previous(이전의, 형용사) → previously(이전에, 부사)

questions.passage: We sincerely apologize for any __________ this may cause and appreciate your patience and cooperation.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 부분을 문맥에 맞게 어형 변환하시오.

"We sincerely apologize for any __________(convenient) this may cause."

det.korean: convenient → inconvenience: any 뒤에 명사가 필요하며, '불편'이라는 부정의 의미이므로 접두사 in- + 명사형.
det.analysis: ✅ inconvenience(불편, 명사): convenient(편리한, 형용사) → convenience(편리함) → inconvenience(불편)
det.tip: convenient(편리한) → convenience(편리함) → inconvenience(불편) — 접두사 in-은 부정

questions.passage: We are committed to completing the work as quickly as possible.
questions.stem:
"우리는 가능한 한 빨리 작업을 완료하는 데 전념하고 있습니다."를 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

We are __________ to completing the work as quickly as possible.

det.korean: ~에 전념하는 = committed to
det.analysis:
✅ ② committed(전념하는): be committed to = ~에 전념하다
❌ ① opposed(반대하는): 반대 의미
❌ ③ indifferent(무관심한): 반대 의미
❌ ④ unrelated(무관한): 다른 의미
det.tip: be committed to + V-ing = ~하는 데 전념하다

questions.passage: During this period, we kindly ask you to use the temporary outdoor parking lot located across from the main entrance.
questions.stem:
"정문 건너편에 위치한 임시 야외 주차장을 이용해 주시기 바랍니다."를 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

Please use the temporary outdoor parking lot __________ the main entrance.

det.korean: ~건너편에 위치한 = located across from
det.analysis:
✅ ① located across from(~건너편에 위치한): 원문 일치
❌ ② located behind(~뒤에): 다른 위치
❌ ③ located inside(~내부에): 다른 위치
❌ ④ located beneath(~아래에): 다른 위치
det.tip: across from = ~건너편에 | located across from = ~건너편에 위치한

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a building or place that provides a particular service or activity"

det.korean: "특정 서비스나 활동을 제공하는 건물이나 장소" = facility(시설)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ facility(시설): 특정 서비스를 제공하는 장소
❌ ① obstacle(장애물): 다른 의미
❌ ② complaint(불만): 다른 의미
❌ ④ scenery(경치): 다른 의미
det.tip: facility = 시설 | facilities = 편의 시설 | parking facility = 주차 시설
